text:
Conflict card - elevator controls in tower_a

Concrete input: fire_alarm is true and seismic is true.

Rule A - "A fire alarm sends the elevator to the ground floor." requires action: ground_floor.

Rule B - "Seismic mode stops at the nearest floor." requires action: nearest_floor.

These actions are incompatible - the elevator cannot both go to the ground floor and stop at the nearest floor at the same time.

Which rule wins for this input?
